payload.prompt:
Create a Europa Universalis V building Icon DDS asset.
Subject: Create a compact vanilla-style Europa Universalis V wonder building icon for Suzhou Classical Gardens, the style 1 final building of Suzhou Classical Gardens. Subject: an iconic Suzhou waterside pavilion with upturned black-tile eaves, one pale Taihu scholar rock, and a lotus pool arc, ink black, white plaster, jade green, and soft lotus pink. Wonder motif for identity only: Suzhou Classical Gardens in their mature Jiangnan form, centered on a refined black-tiled waterside pavilion framed by white plaster walls, moon gates, carved lattice windows, Taihu scholar rocks, lotus ponds, zigzag bridges, bamboo, flowering plum, and glimpsed canals beyond.... Branch note: Water courts, scholar rocks, pavilions, plantings, and inscribed gatherings make the Suzhou Classical Gardens a school of refined cultural patronage. Match vanilla Europa Universalis V building icons: simple painterly brushwork, compact centered crop, clear 128px silhouette, and a restrained palette of 3-4 colors. Use one main architectural symbol plus at most 1-2 tiny supporting shapes. Keep the icon readable after circular crop and mipmap downsizing. No text, letters, numbers, logo, UI frame, full landscape, crowd, or detailed narrative scene.
Reference image: use the uploaded target-specific reference image only as style guidance for palette, brushwork, lighting, surface treatment, and framing discipline. Do not copy its subject, exact composition, silhouette, ornament placement, or any text.
Distinctiveness: keep the result in the same visual family as the reference, but make it visibly different at a glance through changed shape language, object arrangement, cropping, or decorative accents.
Composition: keep the main subject centered, readable, and high-contrast, with no watermark, no letters, no logo, and no UI chrome baked into the art.
Target format: final DDS target is exactly 128x128 and must stay under 100,000 bytes.
Target-specific requirement: Match vanilla Europa Universalis V building icons: simple painterly brushwork, compact centered crop, clear 128px silhouette, and a restrained palette of 3-4 colors. Use one main architectural symbol plus at most 1-2 tiny supporting shapes. Keep the icon readable after circular crop and mipmap downsizing. No text, letters, numbers, logo, UI frame, full landscape, crowd, or detailed narrative scene.
Style rules:
Match the palette, brush feel, lighting, icon density, and framing discipline of the selected target's reference image. Keep the final subject and asset meaning driven by the selected batch entry, not the reference subject.
Extra composition rules:
Use the reference only as a style guide. Keep the result in the same visual family, but make it visibly distinct at a glance by changing the silhouette, crop, object arrangement, and ornament placement. Do not mirror the reference composition or reuse its exact outline.
Avoid:
busy scene, landscape, full panorama, many objects, extra props, crowds, workers, complex scaffolding, detailed narrative scene, ornate palace scene, realistic photo, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, UI frame
